note: Hunter draw weights per difficulty, over tiers (easy, intermediate, difficult). Mirrors Godot game/config/hunter_roster.gd TIER_WEIGHTS_BY_DIFFICULTY (lines 171-174). Hard is the exact midpoint of Standard and Nightmare, as in Godot. A tier with no drawable hunter is dropped and the rest renormalised.

incursion.note: A Void hunter joins a floor as an extra, never a replacement (hunter_roster.gd has_void_incursion, line 298): none before depth min_depth, then base_chance plus per_depth for every floor past min_depth, capped at max_chance.
